data.name: Timezone Lookup
data.description:
Resolve timezone information for a location using IP address, coordinates, place names, airport codes (IATA/ICAO), or UN/LOCODE.
Documentation: https://apifreaks.com/api/timezone-lookup
Quick Start:
- Send a GET request to the timezone endpoint.
- Provide your API key either as query parameter apiKey or as a header (APIFreaks supports both). Example: ?apiKey={{apiKeyValue}}.
- Provide one of the supported input parameters: ip, lat+long, location, tz, iata_code, icao_code, or lo_code (UN/LOCODE).
Parameters Explained:
- apiKey (required): Your APIFreaks API key (can be provided as query param or header). Example variable: {{apiKeyValue}}.
- ip (optional): IPv4 or IPv6 address to determine timezone based on IP geolocation.
- tz (optional): Timezone name (e.g., Europe/London) to directly get timezone data.
- location (optional): City/address string (preferably "City, Country") to geocode and return timezone.
- lat (optional): Latitude (used together with long) to lookup timezone by coordinates.
- long (optional): Longitude (used together with lat) to lookup timezone by coordinates.
- lang (optional): Language code for human-readable location fields. Valid: en, de, ru, ja, fr, cn, es, cs, it. Default: en.
- iata_code (optional): 3-letter IATA airport code to resolve airport + timezone.
- icao_code (optional): 4-letter ICAO airport code to resolve airport + timezone.
- lo_code (optional): 5-character UN/LOCODE to resolve location + timezone.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Usually caused by invalid latitude/longitude formats or invalid codes (IATA/ICAO/UN/LOCODE) — verify parameter formats.
- 404 Not Found: Location / code not found — confirm the input (city spelling, code correctness) or try a different lookup method (coordinates or IP).
- 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden: Missing or invalid API key — provide apiKey as query param or header and ensure it is active.
Edge Cases:
- If multiple locations match a location string, geocoding may pick the best match — include country for disambiguation (e.g., "Springfield, USA").
- IP-based lookups depend on geo-IP databases and may return approximate city-level data for some IPs (esp. mobile carriers).
- Historical timezone data and DST transition details are included; be cautious when using date/time from older timestamps.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- APIFreaks enforces per-account credit limits and rate limits (refer to your APIFreaks account dashboard for exact quotas). Use caching where appropriate to reduce calls.
data.evaluateGuide: Resolves timezone information from a supported location identifier or geographic input.\nUse for: resolve an IP timezone, find a coordinate timezone, look up an airport timezone, identify a place timezone\nNot supported: timezone conversion, calendar scheduling, geocoding
